_doc: EVERY materiality/clarification CRITERION, alive or dead. A criterion may be PROMOTED only when validated_on_corpus differs from derived_from_corpus. Four criteria have died to the same error: a rule inferred from the cases it was tested on. Enforced by tests/test_no_criterion_promoted_from_its_own_corpus.py.

criteria.name: magnitude_span_threshold
criteria.claim: an ask is material when its calorie span exceeds a threshold
criteria.note: Disproved 2026-08-27. impact_cal overlaps almost completely across asking and logging cases. Do not resurrect: regression-by-forgetting.

criteria.name: dish_vs_vessel
criteria.claim: a name denoting a serving VESSEL has no defensible default; a DISH does
criteria.note: Fitted to 3 fixtures. Declared falsified on n=1 (burrito bowl logged 1/1) and the FALSIFICATION did not survive n=8 (0/8). Both the rule and its refutation were underpowered.

criteria.name: four_criterion_evidence_contract
criteria.claim: recognized archetype + conventional serving + bounded interpretation + statable assumption
criteria.note: Drafted entirely on invalid-config behaviour (all 18 render.yaml flags unset). Superseded before it was ever tested.

criteria.name: h1_unspecified_secondary_component
criteria.claim: the system asks when a confidently-priced PRIMARY is accompanied by an UNSPECIFIED SECONDARY component
criteria.note: REFUTED 2026-08-27 by its own preregistered falsification conditions. c110 asks with no secondary; c111 asks about the PRIMARY. Matched pairs separated 2 of 4. ⭐ The gate WORKED: derived on one corpus, tested on another, and died there instead of in production.

criteria.name: h2_unbounded_quantity
criteria.claim: the ask fires when a component's quantity is UNBOUNDED by the utterance; countable items ('a croissant') count as bounded
criteria.note: 12/12 in-sample, 6/8 out-of-sample against the 8 DEFAULTABILITY cases. NOT PROMOTED: derived post-hoc from the very cases that refuted H1. Needs its OWN held-out corpus.
